description: The Navigation Facilities layer is the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers inventory of port and waterway facilities, distributed by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics as part of the National Transportation Atlas Database and listed as a National Geospatial Data Asset (NGDA 152) on GeoPlatform.gov. Contents: 20,548 point features, of which 9,468 are docks and 8,841 are river milepoints, plus fleeting areas, tie-offs and other facility types; 47 attributes cover location (waterway, mile, bank, port and port statistical area), name, owners, operators, purpose, commodities handled, mechanical handling equipment, construction, minimum and maximum depth, largest and total berthing length, deck height, highway and railway access notes and service start date. Producer: USACE, updated periodically. Coverage: United States coastal, Great Lakes and inland waterway ports and territories. Format and access: ArcGIS feature service with query and download through the BTS geodata portal in CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON and file geodatabase; no registration. Licence: CC0 1.0 as listed on data.gov. Caveats: attributes are free text in places (operators, commodities, handling), milepoints are reference points, not facilities, and capacity is given as berthing length and depth, not throughput. Simulation uses: building port and terminal nodes for freight network models, hurricane, flood and low-water exposure of docks, and intermodal rail and road connection analysis. Related records: the USACE National Waterway Network (data-usace-national-waterway-network) gives the links these facilities sit on, and the National Transportation Atlas Database (data-us-national-transportation-atlas-database) is the parent collection.
